title: NORMBANK: A Knowledge Bank of Situational Social Norms

bias_targets.methodology: Mitigated and evaluated during dataset construction by neutralizing gender-specific role constraints (e.g., changing '[PERSON]'s role is cowboy' to 'cowboy or cowgirl') to prevent skewed or stereotypical representations.

Administering political leaning and moral foundations surveys to annotators to evaluate how personal, cultural, and political backgrounds influence subjective normative judgments and account for annotator disagreements.
